units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 6:3">Targ. Jud. VI, 3</cite>; a. fr.—Part. <cite ref="G00723"><he>זָרֵעַ</he></cite>, (<cite ref="G00710"><he>זְרִיעַ</he></cite>) <cite ref="G00710"><he>זָרֵיעַ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 11:18">Targ. Prov. XI, 18</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 28:25">Targ. Is. XXVIII, 25</cite> <he>זָרְעֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 16a:4">R. Hash. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>לִיזְרַע חרפא</he> let him sow early seed (barley &c.).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 7:3:15">Y. Peah VII, 20ᵇ</cite> top <he>הוה ז׳ חקלא וכ׳</he> planted carrots on his field; a. fr.

senses.gloss: as preced. Hif. Y. Kil. I, 27ᵃ bot. ומַזְרְעִין and they copulated.
